Chris (Customer Admin): Hey team — after our IdP sync this morning the free-trial credits (grant id cg_2026_998) landed on a stale project instead of our main prod project. billing shows the credits attached to workspace staging-2022-ghost under org org_arkham_42. Can you help reassign?
Emma (CS): Sorry about that, Chris. Can you paste the org_id and target workspace id + the email of the user who initiated the promo? I’ll open a ticket and escalate. :pray:
Chris (Customer Admin): Org: org_arkham_42
Current (wrong) workspace: staging-2022-ghost (ws_7788)
Desired workspace: prod-app (ws_1199)
Promo/grant id: cg_2026_998
Initiating user: chris@acme.com
Grant timestamp: 2026-03-17T09:11:58Z
IDP user externalId: 123e4567
IDP Bot: ```SAML_SYNC: completed 2026-03-17T09:12:03Z
externalId=123e4567 -> linked to workspace=staging-2022-ghost (ws_7788)
actions=[create_user chris@acme.com, link_identity]```
Emma (CS): Thanks — escalating to eng. @Ravi can you check the audit logs for credit.apply events around that timestamp? I created ticket TKT-3482 and added the customer.
Ravi (Eng): Looking now. I can see an event: `credit.apply grant_id=cg_2026_998 target_workspace=staging-2022-ghost triggered_by=identity_link(externalId=123e4567) actor=sync-service`. It looks like the IdP mapping matched the archived duplicate workspace instead of prod-app.
Ravi (Eng): We can run a controlled reassignment (admin tool) to move the grant to ws_1199. I'll need ops approval and a green light from the customer to proceed.
Julie (Ops): @Emma Ops needs customer explicit consent and a small audit trail. Chris, do you authorize moving the entire grant cg_2026_998 from ws_7788 -> ws_1199? This will update billing allocation.
Chris (Customer Admin): Yes please move full amount to prod-app (ws_1199). We confirm.
Ravi (Eng): Plan: run a dry-run first to show the delta:
```
redwood-admin credits-transfer --grant cg_2026_998 --from ws_7788 --to ws_1199 --dry-run
# verify output -> then without --dry-run to apply
```
I will capture the operation id and post logs to TKT-3482. ETA ~20m.
Emma (CS): Thanks — I’ll update the ticket and notify billing. Also opening a follow-up to investigate the SSO mapping rules so the IdP sync prefers active workspace aliases.
Ravi (Eng): Dry-run looks clean. Running apply now. op_id=op_55b9c
IDP Bot: ```CREDIT_TRANSFER op=op_55b9c status=applied grant=cg_2026_998 from=ws_7788 to=ws_1199 timestamp=2026-03-17T09:14:35Z```
Ravi (Eng): Done. Credits show on prod-app and removed from staging-2022-ghost. I’ve attached the audit lines to TKT-3482.
Emma (CS): Closing the loop with the customer and flagging an SSO mapping bug for prioritization. Thanks for quick turnaround everyone :thumbsup:
Chris (Customer Admin): Appreciate it — thanks Emma / Ravi / Julie.
